description: This is a C source file implementing a routing service component for a network device. It manages registration and unregistration of routing-related events and handles command-line arguments for starting, stopping, or restarting the service.

methods.name: srv_register
methods.description: Registers the routing service and sets initial system state.

methods.name: stop_service
methods.description: Stops the routing service (conditional on RDKB_EXTENDER_ENABLED).

methods.name: srv_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the routing service and performs cleanup.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that processes command-line arguments to start, stop, or restart the service.
